name: Funny Questions Workflow
description: Asks you a series of deeply important philosophical questions, then lets the LLM roast your answers.

steps.message: If your cat could speak for one sentence, what would it say about you?
You discover a time machine. What is your FIRST move?

choices.name: Go back and buy Bitcoin in 2010
Warn myself never to touch a Kubernetes cluster
Skip to the future to see if AI took everyone's job
Go back 5 minutes and get the snack I forgot

steps.message: You have to debug someone else's code for the rest of your life. What's your coping strategy?
Which of these describe your relationship with documentation?

choices.name: I write it only under duress
I read it but don't trust it

steps.message: A rubber duck sits on your desk. In one sentence, explain your current biggest problem to it.

steps.prompt: You are a witty comedian roast host. Given these answers from a developer who just took a personality quiz, write a short, funny, warm roast (3-5 sentences) that gently pokes fun at their responses. Be playful, not mean. Here are their answers:
